docs.title: The Danna Langkawi Resort & Beach Villas

children.text: Showcasing Langkawi’s stunning scenic beauty, the award-winning Danna Langkawi Resort & Beach Villas welcomes you with genuine island hospitality while delighting you at every turn. Take your time to explore this luxury beachfront resort which features exclusive private pool villas, colonial oceanfront rooms and suites that boast views ranging from tropical mountains, ocean, marina and courtyard – featuring bespoke Jo Loves by Jo Malone CBE bath amenities. Indulge in eclectic and intimate seaside dining, keep up with your wellness regime at the Techno gym fitness centre or rejuvenate over therapeutic treatments at The Spa for balance of body, mind and soul. Located in Telaga Harbour Park, this Mediterranean-inspired beach resort is easily accessible to many of Langkawi’s famous attractions and outdoor activities. It takes approximately 15 minutes from the Langkawi International Airport and 25 minutes from Pantai Cenang to The Danna Langkawi Resort & Beach Villas.
•   Luxurious beachfront resort and pool villas
The Danna Langkawi Resort & Beach Villas is situated in the beautiful Telaga Harbour Park, Langkawi, offering easy access to nearby attractions, beaches, and cultural sites.
15 minutes by car from Langkawi International Airport
Nearest railway station is inn Alor Star, and requires a ferry ride to Langkawi
Drive towards Langkawi Cable Car, the resort is 25 minutes away from Cenang Beach
The Danna Langkawi offers a choices of luxurious accommodations including private pool villas, colonial-style rooms, and bespoke suites, perfect for both couples and families.

Relax in the Merchant Twin room, offering two plush beds, a private balcony, and an elegant marble bathroom with serene mountain or courtyard views. Delight in luxury amenities and attentive service.

Experience grandeur in the Grand Marina View room with a spacious balcony, oversized daybed, and stunning marina views. Revel in sophisticated furnishings, exclusive amenities, and exceptional service.
Indulge in the Viceroy King Seaview room with a private balcony overlooking the Andaman Sea. Bask in luxurious comfort, mesmerizing sea views, and top-tier amenities for a perfect escape.
Unwind in the Viceroy Twin room, featuring two plush beds, a private balcony, and spectacular Andaman Sea views. Enjoy refined decor, modern amenities, and exceptional service.

Embrace serenity in the Merchant 2-Bedroom Suite with a kitchenette, ample space, and thoughtful amenities. Ideal for families or friends, with exclusive privileges for a memorable stay. Available in a configuration of two King Bedrooms or 1 King and 1 twin .

Discover the pinnacle of luxury in the Merchant 3-Bedroom Suite, featuring a spacious living area, kitchenette, and exquisite amenities. Ideal for families and small groups seeking a stylish retreat.

Experience unparalleled opulence in the Marina 4-Bay Suite with two bedrooms, a separate lounge, dining area, and a private infinity pool. Enjoy breathtaking Marina and Andaman Sea views, plus a sauna and personal treadmill.
Indulge in the Princess Beach Villa, a beachfront sanctuary with a private pool, expansive living area, and standalone bathtub overlooking a beautifully curated garden, ensuring total privacy.

Experience the Empress Beach Villa, a luxurious two-bedroom beachfront retreat with a private lap pool and elegant kitchenette. Perfect for families and friends, offering refined luxury and stunning ocean views.

Get married on the ocean’s edge accompanied by the sound of the waves and gentle sea breeze. At The Danna Langkawi, rejoice in that special moment while exchanging your vows on a secluded wedding venue by the beach with close family and friends followed by a party under the stars. With our dedicated wedding team assisting you every step of the way, nothing is impossible in creating that ultimate beach wedding in a perfect location in Langkawi, Malaysia!

The Danna Langkawi houses a variety of restaurants and lounges offering local and international specialties. From casual to elegant dining, romantic dinner by the beach or an intimate family gathering, you will discover your perfect place to eat while you're in Langkawi.

Experience a touch of Italy at the Terrace as it showcases classic Italian dishes within a modern dining setting. Feast on favourites like fresh seafood and homemade pasta paired with an excellent selection of wines and cocktails. Open for lunch and dinner, you have a choice of enjoying your meal alfresco overlooking our infinity pool or within the more relaxed indoor seating.

cards.title: Planter’s Breakfast Buffet, Asian & European Cuisine

children.text: Planter’s Breakfast Buffet, Asian & European Cuisine

Discover the culinary delights at Planter’s Restaurant, your all-day dining destination in Langkawi. Start your mornings with a vibrant bubbly buffet breakfast, followed by an enticing à la carte lunch menu featuring a global selection and locally inspired specialties like rendang, satay, and more. As night falls, immerse yourself in the rich flavors of Malaysia with our scrumptious Heritage Buffet dinner, offering a captivating array of traditional Malaysian dishes. Planter’s is where exceptional dining meets unforgettable experiences.
Savor the essence of Malaysian heritage at Straits & Co, The Danna Langkawi’s authentic Peranakan restaurant. Enjoy a memorable dinner showcasing vibrant Peranakan flavors in a relaxed ambiance.

Peranakan culture, rooted in the 14th-century migration of Chinese settlers to Southeast Asia, is known for its unique blend of Sino-Malay influences. This heritage shines through in colorful attire, intricate Nyonya dishes, and traditional music, offering a dining experience rich in history and flavor.

Escape to STC Café & Deli, where afternoons from 11am to 6pm are made for indulgence. Unwind with a perfectly brewed coffee or tea, and savor a selection of seasonal desserts and pastries crafted with the finest ingredients. Enjoy our Signature Afternoon Tea, complete with homemade scones in a cozy, inviting ambiance designed for leisurely moments.

With its elegant leather and wood decor furnished with bold tones, the Churchill Room offers cigar connoisseurs a refined retreat. Known as one of the best ventilated cigar lounges in the country, you can enjoy specially curated pairings of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages with a selection of cigars that includes the room’s namesake's favourite brand - Romeo y Julieta
*Enjoy the finer things in life with Curated Pairing Experience which pairs a chosen cigar with a high-end single malt whisky, aged rum, premium brandy or non-alcoholic beverage.

Step back in time to the glamorous days of the 1920s at The Verandah Lounge. Known as one of Langkawi’s classiest lounges, you’ll be greeted with a visually stunning display of soaring high ceilings, magnificent chandeliers and towering pillars. This hidden gem is effortlessly stylish where you can unwind on plush sofas and indulge in nibbles and cocktails.
